stem.text: A sky-diver falls from a stationary balloon at time $t = 0$. As the sky-diver falls, her speed and the air resistance increase until the force of the air resistance is equal to her weight.
Which graph best shows the variation with time $t$ of the displacement $s$ for the motion of the sky-diver?

A.alt: Graph of s against t with both axes labelled and the origin marked 0; a curved line rising from the origin.

B.alt: Graph of s against t with both axes labelled and the origin marked 0; a line that starts curved from the origin and then becomes straight.

C.alt: Graph of s against t with both axes labelled and the origin marked 0; a curved line rising steeply from the origin and levelling off.

D.alt: Graph of s against t with both axes labelled and the origin marked 0; a straight line rising from the origin.
